title: A Toeplitz corona theorem for the pentablock and applications
summary: We state and prove a Toeplitz corona theorem for the pentablock $\mathbb{P}$, a domain in $\mathbb{C}^3$ given by \[ \mathbb{P}=\{(a_{21}, \text{tr}(A), \det(A)) \in \mathbb C^3 : A=[a_{ij}] \in M_2(\mathbb C), \|A\|<1\}. \] By two different applications of this theorem, we obtain a few new characterizations in the Toeplitz corona theorems for the bidisc and the symmetrized bidisc.
